title: Premier Protein Expands into Convenience Channel With the Debut of Ultimate 42g Protein Shakes in 7-Eleven, Inc. Stores
summary: Premier Protein Expands into Convenience Channel With the Debut of Ultimate 42g Protein Shakes in 7-Eleven, Inc. Stores

**EMERYVILLE , Calif., November 16 , 2026 –** Premier Protein, America’s leading ready-to-drink ( RTD


) protein shake brand will now be available in even more moments that matter: on-the-go, during busy days, commutes, travel stops and everyday convenience occasions. The brand is expanding into convenience at scale through a new collaboration with 7


‑Eleven, the world’s largest convenience retailer. Rolling onto shelves this November, Ultimate Chocolate and Café Latte 42


g Protein Shakes can be found in participating 7


‑Eleven, Speedway and Stripes locations across the country.


Premier Protein Ultimate has 42


g of protein, 220


calories and 2


grams of sugar in every 14


oz bottle, giving you more protein to power your day and keeping you feeling fuller, longer. Beginning November 23


, customers can find the two irresistible, best-selling flavors of the new Premier Protein Ultimate shakes: Chocolate and Café Latte (which contains the caffeine equivalent of one cup of coffee!) at participating stores. Ultimate, which debuted this past summer, also contains vitamins C and E, fueling more than just your muscles by delivering crucial antioxidants to give your immune system the defense it needs to tackle busy days.


The rollout significantly expands access to Premier Protein nationwide, bringing the brand closer to consumers in participating 7


‑Eleven stores across the country and meeting the growing demand for convenient, high-protein options that fit active lifestyles without compromising on flavor or nutritional benefits.


“


We are so excited to team up with 7


‑Eleven to bring Premier Protein beyond traditional club, mass, and food retail channels and create new opportunities to meet consumers where they are,” said Derek Walters, Director of Broker Operations for Premium Nutrition Corporation.


​ “


By bringing the brand into the convenience channel, we’re making high-quality, great tasting protein options more accessible than ever and helping consumers achieve their protein goals wherever their day brings them.”


Premier Protein Ultimate will roll out to participating 7


‑Eleven locations nationwide starting November 23


and can be found in the refrigerated drinks section. To learn more and find out where to purchase, visit[www​.Pre​mier​Pro​tein​.com](http://www.premierprotein.com/) .
